visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, wavy brown hair and a light pink fuzzy sweater is seen against a plain white background. She holds a red envelope and smiles warmly while performing a clapping gesture. (2) The woman presents a Bobbi Brown cushion compact to the camera. She then uses a makeup puff to apply the product to her face, looking into a side mirror to ensure even coverage. (3) She uses a large fluffy brush to apply loose powder over her face. Her expressions are focused and pleasant throughout the application. (4) Using a thin pencil, she carefully fills in her eyebrows while looking into a small handheld mirror. (5) She showcases a SUQQU eyeshadow palette. She applies pink and shimmer shades to her eyelids and lower lash line using both her fingers and a small brush for precision. (6) She applies mascara to her upper lashes and draws a fine line with an eyeliner pen. (7) A pink four-color blush palette is shown. She uses a brush to apply a soft pink shade to her cheeks, the tip of her nose, and her chin. (8) She applies a pinkish-red lipstick from a gold tube, finishing her makeup look. (9) The woman poses for the camera, tilting her head and smiling to show the complete 'good daughter-in-law' makeup. She finishes by clasping her hands in a traditional greeting.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 咚咚咚鏘. [Slogan]: 新年快樂. (2) [Subtitle]: 今天我要來分享一個集溫柔與智慧於一身的好媳婦妝，讓大家好過年. (3) [Subtitle]: 那首先我來用一個我最近很喜歡的 Bobbi brown冬蟲夏草的粉餅. (4) [Subtitle]: 它的保濕修飾以及遮瑕都超級好的. (5) [Subtitle]: 用蜜粉稍微定個妝. (6) [Subtitle]: 眉毛的部分呢就畫的有精神就可以了. (7) [Subtitle]: 在今天的主角就是將將 SUQQU的眼影盤. (8) [Subtitle]: 這個不管你會不會化妝，你只要用它畫出來絕對就是溫柔與智慧兼具的女子. (9) [Subtitle]: 深色的部分的話眼頭跟眼尾的地方. (10) [Subtitle]: 這裡有點小小失誤但沒關係，我們用氣墊粉撲呢把它做一個暈染就沒問題啦. (11) [Subtitle]: 最後在我們眼皮中間呢做一個打亮. (12) [Subtitle]: 然後刷上睫毛，畫上眼線就大功告成啦. (13) [Subtitle]: 是不是很溫柔呢. (14) [Subtitle]: 然後腮紅的部分呢，我是選擇比較裸粉色系的. (15) [Subtitle]: 淡淡的就好了，因為眼睛是我們今天的主角. (16) [Subtitle]: 所以有點淡淡的好氣色就可以嘍，不要太紅，這樣子會太過多. (17) [Subtitle]: 鼻子跟下巴也刷一點點. (18) [Subtitle]: 最後再刷上SUQQU的唇膏，一刷唇紋都沒有了，超級厲害的. (19) [Subtitle]: 今天的好媳婦妝就完成啦. (20) [Subtitle]: 是不是很溫柔有智慧的感覺呢. (21) [Subtitle]: 所以就恭喜發財紅包拿來啦.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A festive, mid-tempo electronic BGM with a strong, upbeat rhythm begins. A high-pitched female voice enthusiastically greets the audience with 'Dong dong dong qiang!', accompanied by the sound of rhythmic clapping. (2) The narration shifts to a friendly, calm professional tone as the speaker describes her first makeup step. The BGM ducks in volume to allow the vocal to remain clear. Sharp, short plastic clicks are heard as she opens a cushion compact. (3) The vocal continues at a moderate pace, detailing the application of loose powder and eyebrow drawing. Soft rustling sounds of brush bristles are barely audible over the music. (4) The speaker introduces an eyeshadow palette with an excited inflection ('Jiang jiang!'). The acoustic texture is clean with high spectral brightness. The BGM maintains a consistent major-mode feel. (5) As she explains the final touches of mascara and lipstick, her tone remains high-valence and energetic. The audio quality is studio-grade with no noticeable distortion or noise. (6) The video concludes with festive well-wishes. The vocal intensity rises slightly at the end, and the music swells briefly before fading out.
